column1: #   id  version  codename  released  eol  kind
#   version   matches VERSION_ID=, or * for a rolling release
#   codename  - when the distro does not use one
#   released  YYYY-MM-DD, or - when not known to a useful precision
#   eol       YYYY-MM-DD, or - for rolling and for dates not yet announced
# THIS TABLE GOES STALE. It is consulted only when /etc/os-release does not carry
# SUPPORT_END=, which Fedora, RHEL, and the RHEL rebuilds do ship — for those, the
# live field always wins and this table is never read for support status.
# Data as of: 2026-08-01. Refresh from https://endoflife.date (their JSON API has one
# endpoint per product) and bump the date above. An entry that cannot be confirmed is
# omitted rather than guessed: a missing row prints "unknown", a wrong row lies.
# Rolling distros get one row with version * — there is nothing to expire.
